note: THE FIDELITY LEDGER — every L0 authored field that does NOT reach the CommandEventBridge emit for its family, named with the mechanism, the reason and the user-visible consequence. SHRINK-ONLY: a new drop with no row here fails the gate at exit 3, and a row whose drop has been fixed must LEAVE in the commit that fixes it (arm A5, also exit 3). Rows are derived from audit/full-stack/2026-08-31/builders/, which measured 26 drawable families: 24 DRAW, 6 draw what the user authored. This file is the migration backlog for the other 18, not absolution for them.

drops.reason: C75 provenance is authored at L0 on every element kind and is carried by NO *.created emit. It is not a geometry input: `grep -rn "\.provenance" packages/geometry-slab/src packages/geometry-wall/src packages/geometry-roof/src` returns ZERO — no fragment builder reads it. It rides the PERSISTENCE leg (C13), which is a different axis than this gate measures, and check-provenance-coverage is the gate that owns it.
drops.consequence: none at the mesh. A reader must NOT infer from this row that provenance survives a save — that is check-snapshot-family-coverage’s question, not this one.

drops.reason: C75 confidence, the same shape as provenance above and measured the same way: authored at L0, read by no fragment builder, carried on the persistence leg.
drops.consequence: none at the mesh; the same caveat about the persistence leg applies.

drops.reason: a field-name count over the 4927-file identifier index finds ZERO mentions of `rotation` in BeamTypes.ts: the legacy beam record has nowhere to put it. drops.consequence: a rotated beam draws unrotated, on every path, including the one that works.
